description: Strom-/Gas-Versorgungsgebiet der SachsenEnergie-Unternehmens-Gruppe (WMS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten.sachsen-netze.de. The SachsenEnergie group of companies is, among other things, a utility network operator in East Saxony. The external borders of the electricity/gas supply areas of the company subsidiary SachsenNetze are stored as an area in a geoinformation system. This external supply area boundary is available in the form of a WMS service. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity/gas supply area of the SachsenEnergie-Unternehmens-Gruppe (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Versorgungsgebiet Strom, Versorgungsgebiet Gas. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-03-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
